youtube.title: Twiggy's ABC: P to T! (BONK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🌳 BONK! An apple fell on Twiggy the tree, and all the letter blocks tumbled down! Can you help Twiggy find them?

Learn the letters P, Q, R, S and T with Twiggy! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: P is for pumpkin, Q is for quiet, R is for rainbow, S is for snow, and T is for tree, just like Twiggy! Visit the pumpkin farm, a quiet night, the rainbow sky and the snowy hills. Then sing the letter song with Twiggy, and stay till the end, because a surprise letter is waiting way up high! ☁️

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters P, Q, R, S and T
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (P is for pumpkin!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a happy alphabet song with Twiggy the tree!
